Gold Prices Surge to Two-Month High Amid Global Market Volatility

Gold prices reached a two-month high, with 10 grams trading at Rs 1.57 lakh. This surge occurred despite rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Analysts have issued warnings about potential future price "tsunamis." In global markets, European stocks eased from record highs, and bond yields in Japan and the Eurozone showed mixed movements ahead of US inflation data. Korean bond yields hit a record high.
